name: Steps
description: A progress indicator for a short flow like sign-up or checkout. It shows which step you're on, which are done and which are still to come.

classes.ayy-steps: Root <ol>, a row of steps with lines between them. Numbers come from a CSS counter.
classes.ayy-steps--sm: Small: markers a step under the sm control height, text --ayy-text-xs.
classes.ayy-steps--lg: Large: markers the md control height, text --ayy-text-md.
classes.ayy-steps--vertical: A column, with the lines running down between the markers: for a side panel or a phone.
classes.ayy-steps__item: A step <li>. aria-current="step" marks the current one (filled marker, bold label); every step before it is drawn as done (tick, solid line); the ones after as to do.
classes.ayy-steps__label: The step's name, one line (cut with an ellipsis in the row).

default.looks: To do: a muted number in a line-strong circle with a line to the next step.

disabled.none: Steps after the current one already read as to do.

selected.looks: Current: marker filled with the text colour, semibold label. Steps before it are done: a tick in a text-colour circle and a solid line. Forced colours: Highlight marker.

error.none: No error look; put the problem in the step's content (Alert, FieldError).

scale.sm: Markers --ayy-size-control-xs tall (24px compact, 28 comfortable, 36 touch), --ayy-text-xs labels.
scale.md: Markers --ayy-size-control-dense tall, the sm control height by default (28px compact, 32 comfortable, 40 touch); --ayy-text-sm labels. A data-size scope moves it: sm to the xs height, lg to the md height.
scale.lg: Markers the md control height (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch), --ayy-text-md labels.

sizes.density: Every marker follows data-density with the control scale.
sizes.width: Fills its container. In a row narrower than 36rem only the current step keeps a visible label; vertical stacks them for a side panel or phone.

js: stepsClass({ size?, vertical?, className? }) → string; stepsItemClass, stepsLabelClass constants.

props.steps: ReactNode[] — the step names, in order.
props.doneLabel: Read before a finished step's name. Default "Done: " (translate it).

a11y: It's an ordered list with aria-current="step" on the current item, so screen readers hear "step 2 of 4, current". Give the <ol> an aria-label ("Checkout progress").
Done steps say so in text, not only with a tick: put an .ayy-sr-only "Done: " before their label (React does it).
The markers are generated content with empty alt text, so numbers aren't read twice.
do: Use steps above a multi-page form or wizard with three to five steps, so people know how much is left.
Name steps by what happens in them (Account, Team, Billing), in one or two words.
Use the vertical version beside a long form on wide screens, or when the row wouldn't fit a phone.
dont: Don't use steps for page navigation or for switching views — use Tabs or links.
Don't use them for a single form — a Progress bar or nothing at all reads better.
Don't use them for pages of results — use Pagination.
Don't make more than about five; split the flow instead.
